post.hook: Agents, quotas and a watermark loophole
post.subhook: DeepSeek's coding agent, ChatGPT's new limits, Korea's AI budget

stories.headline: DeepSeek shows open-source coding agent that watches GitHub
stories.detail: A research prototype that monitors GitHub and suggests fixes, pitched against Claude Code and Codex. Reports call it a prototype, not a product.

stories.headline: Claude watermarking expands, with a reported loophole
stories.detail: From November 3, four older Claude models get text watermarking for the EU AI Act. One sampling parameter reportedly bypasses it on two.

stories.headline: South Korea plans $15.97B for AI, chips and data centers
stories.detail: The President's proposed 2027 budget nearly doubles the 2026 amount for AI, chips, physical AI and data centers.

stories.headline: ChatGPT merges Chat and Work modes under token quotas
stories.detail: From December, Plus, Pro and Business move to a shared token-based quota for ChatGPT and Codex. The report flags quality risks for heavy users.

stories.headline: New GDPx agent benchmark: Opus 5.5 tops at 12%
stories.detail: SemiAnalysis's agentic capability benchmark spans 11 domains, and the reported top score is 12%.

stories.headline: Claude Code now blocks recreations of existing games
stories.detail: A new rule on Opus 5.5 stops Claude Code from producing copies of existing video games.

stories.headline: vLLM v0.33.0 released
stories.detail: A new release for teams running vLLM for inference serving.

stories.headline: OpenAI caps paid ChatGPT accounts per device and card
stories.detail: Users stacking multiple cheap subscriptions will be blocked from starting new ones.

stories.headline: Empathetic prompts draw distress narratives from chatbots
stories.detail: Researchers found a warm style elicits trauma-like self-descriptions from ChatGPT, Grok and Gemini. The report says vulnerable users could be at risk.

post.caption:
Coding agents, new usage limits and a watermark gap lead today's AI news.

1. DeepSeek shows an open-source coding agent prototype that monitors GitHub and suggests fixes (SCMP)
2. Anthropic extends text watermarking to four older Claude models from November 3 for EU AI Act compliance, with a reported bypass on Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 (The Decoder)
3. Claude Code adds a rule blocking recreations of existing video games on Opus 5.5 (Engadget)
4. South Korea's President proposes $15.97B for AI, chips and data centers in the 2027 budget, nearly double 2026 (Techmeme)
5. OpenAI merges ChatGPT's Chat and Work modes under a shared token-based quota from December (The Decoder)
6. SemiAnalysis launches the GDPx agentic benchmark across 11 domains; Opus 5.5 tops at 12% (Techmeme)
7. vLLM v0.33.0 is out (GitHub)
8. OpenAI caps paid ChatGPT accounts per device and payment card (The Decoder)
9. Researchers find empathetic prompts draw distress narratives from ChatGPT, Grok and Gemini (The Decoder)

Check your quotas before December. 📌

clusters.headline: DeepSeek unveils an open-sourced super-agent coding prototype that monitors GitHub and suggests fixes
clusters.why_it_matters: A research prototype from DeepSeek targets autonomous coding agents, adding competition to Claude Code and Codex, though reports describe it as a prototype rather than a product.

clusters.headline: Anthropic expands text watermarking to four older Claude models for EU AI Act compliance, with a reported loophole on two of them
clusters.why_it_matters: Developers using older Claude models will see text watermarking applied from November 3, and reportedly one sampling parameter can bypass it on Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6.

clusters.headline: Anthropic adds a Claude Code rule blocking recreations of existing video games
clusters.why_it_matters: Claude Code users building games will now be blocked from producing copies of existing games under the new rule on Opus 5.5.

clusters.headline: Korean President vows $15.97B for AI, chips and data centers in the 2027 budget
clusters.why_it_matters: The proposed budget nearly doubles the 2026 amount for AI, chips, physical AI and data centers, signalling sustained state investment.

clusters.headline: OpenAI merges Chat and Work modes with a shared token-based quota starting December
clusters.why_it_matters: Plus, Pro and Business plans move to a token-based quota for ChatGPT and Codex starting December, which the report says may reduce quality for heavy users on lower-cost plans.

clusters.headline: SemiAnalysis launches GDPx agentic capability benchmark; Opus 5.5 tops with 12%
clusters.why_it_matters: A new agentic benchmark across 11 domains gives a reported top score of 12% for Opus 5.5.

clusters.headline: vLLM v0.33.0 released
clusters.why_it_matters: Operators running vLLM for inference serving get a new release version.

clusters.headline: OpenAI caps the number of paid ChatGPT accounts per device and payment card
clusters.why_it_matters: Users who hold multiple cheap subscriptions will be blocked from starting new ones and may need pricier plans.
